explication: Flyte 2 is presented as an ML workflow and model-serving platform; this repository is its emerging Kubernetes-native backend, not the Python SDK. The principal visible runtime path is a Kubernetes TaskAction being reconciled and dispatched to a task plugin, whose state and result are reflected in the action status. Separate backend services expose cache, data proxy, app, action, event, and auth capabilities. The README says the open-source backend is still coming; the graph therefore shows documented subsystems but only asserts links supported by sampled source or explicit documentation.
